description.narrative: The transaction encompasses a total 10yr loan of USD 20 mln, in which Agri3 would take a 40% maturity subordination risk participation. This includes yearly input purchasing that would allow to restore soils with organic compost and in turn lead to reduction of inorganic fertilizers. The company is estimating these to be c. BRL 22 mln in 2023, c. BRL 16.7 mln in 2024 and BRL 14 mln in 2025, and gradually decreasing through the years. In addition to that, it is to extend the use of biologicals through further input purchase, decreasing the amount of chemical defensives in 80,000 liters per year, which shall have a cost of c. BRL 8 mln yearly. Next to that, the loan would also support the company on planting 430 ha of orange trees (targeted regenerative practices under Gold standard).
